title: AGLHook — v4 hook deployed despite 'must not be deployed' (Ethereum, ~$1.45M pooled)
closed_reasons: fee/delta math correct in all 4 swap shapes on the live v4 PoolManager; fee is exactly 10% of the gross ETH leg
feeBps is a pure function of a write-once launchTs (2026-10-01) and block.timestamp; no setter -> cannot skew to 0% or otherwise
sole feeExempt address (AGLBuyback) reaches PoolManager.swap only via operator-gated buyAndBurn, which burns the AGL it buys
int128 casts unreachable: _collect -> poolManager.mint SafeCast.toInt128 reverts for fee >= 2**127
owed() == ERC-6909 ETH claim exactly -> no unbacked mint
all callbacks onlyPoolManager; beforeInitialize gated by openTrading state; hook not rebindable
claim() pays only the immutable xautFundWallet (0x06fbfb28...)
no owner/admin/proxy/setters on the hook; AGL owner cannot mint/pause/re-open; launch LP locked in the token
key_facts: hook 0xA61d74D6362699B76b21ef3016649A58D27bE0CC, flags 0x20CC = bI+bS+bSD+aS+aSD, matches address bits and constructor check
poolKey (ETH, AGL 0x63401cDd..., fee=0, tickSpacing=60, hook), poolId 0x02a13b05...93bf, launchTs 1790852411 (2026-10-01 11:00:11 UTC)
pool reserves ~282.44 ETH + ~115.95M AGL; ETH $2402.65 (DefiLlama) => TVL ~ $1.45M
feeExempt = {0x8CCf65a2d5edFF1AAF865e6D75e70077a0e0bce5 = AGLBuyback}; buyback operator is EOA 0x6979...e119; buyAndBurn isOperator-gated
owed == PoolManager.balanceOf(hook, id=0) at the same block; hook native ETH balance 0
xautFundWallet 0x06fbfb283bCA0d109bFB5Fd9CFb02B974D705998 is an EOA (immutable); 285 FeeClaimed events totalling 212.115 ETH
no owner()/admin()/paused(), EIP-1967 impl slot 0x0 (not a proxy)
caveats: the deployed code is the post-fix version; the 'not finished' header is a stale doc comment
the ~21k AGL split off the PoolManager's AGL balance to other AGL pools opened at launch is inferred; does not affect any conclusion
ETH price is point-in-time DefiLlama 2026-10-23; the 99%->10% buy-fee decay window is historical (launch 2026-10-01)
generic MEV around the fee-exempt AGLBuyback buys exists but is not a protocol drain
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from AGLHook's ~$1.45M ETH/AGL pool: the two-callback 10% fee and its int128 deltas are correct on the live PoolManager, every callback is PoolManager-only, the only fee-exempt address is operator-gated and burns its output, and claim() pays only an immutable wallet.
